description.desc: 劳拉娜有 20 项成就。你每完成一项她的成就，她会获得一层“战役”堆叠层数。

description.desc: Laurana increases the damage of Champions in the column behind her by $amount%.
劳拉娜使她后方第一列中的勇士伤害提高 $amount%。

specializationDescription.original: Laurana orders a direct advance with her closest allies.
specializationDescription.display: 劳拉娜命令她最亲密的盟友与她一起发起正面冲锋。

description.desc: Laurana increases the damage of Champions in the column that is two columns behind her by $amount%.
劳拉娜使她后方第二列中的勇士伤害提高 $amount%。

specializationDescription.original: Laurana attacks from unexpected angles to shatter enemy lines.
specializationDescription.display: 劳拉娜从意想不到的角度杀出，撕碎敌人的防线。

description.desc: Laurana increases the damage of Champions in the column that is three columns behind her by $amount%.
劳拉娜使她后方第三列中的勇士伤害提高 $amount%。

specializationDescription.original: Laurana reinforces the back, ensuring a devastating attack when the moment is right.
specializationDescription.display: 劳拉娜巩固后方阵线，为时机成熟时发动毁灭性一击做好准备。

description.desc: The effect of Laurana's chosen Battle Plan specialization choice is increased by $amount% for each Campaign stack she has, stacking multiplicatively.
劳拉娜每拥有一层“战役”堆叠层数，她选中的“作战计划”专精选择效果提高 $amount%，以乘算方式堆叠。

tipText.original: Laurana's Battle Plan affects one of the three columns behind her (your choice); this buff is greatly increased by her Campaign stacks, which you can increase by completing her extra achievements.
tipText.display: 劳拉娜的“作战计划”会影响她身后三列中的一列（由你选择）；此项增益会随着她的“战役”堆叠层数而大幅提升，你可通过完成她的额外成就来增加该堆叠层数。

description.desc: Laurana's Soldiers are Heroes of the Lance Champions. Laurana gains Army stacks equal to the number of Soldiers in the formation, or the number of Campaign stacks she has divided by 2, whichever is lower. Laurana increases the effect of her chosen Battle Plan specialization choice by $amount% for each Army stack that she has, stacking multiplicatively. A specialization choice and certain feats can add more Champions who are her Soldiers.

specializationDescription.original: Laurana's keen tactics grants her Soldiers the ability to critically hit more often and more effectively.
specializationDescription.display: 劳拉娜高明的战术使她的士兵能够更频繁地打出暴击，并造成更高的伤害。

description.desc: Laurana increases her maximum health by $amount%. Additionally, Champions with a Constitution of 12 or lower also count as Laurana's Soldiers.
劳拉娜使她的最大生命值增加 $amount%。此外，体质小于等于 12 的勇士也算作劳拉娜的士兵。

specializationDescription.original: Laurana increases her fortitude and recruits Soldiers that others may overlook.
specializationDescription.display: 劳拉娜使自身变得更加坚韧，并招募那些可能会被其他人忽视的士兵。

description.desc: Laurana gains the Hunter role. Dragons and Monstrosities become her favored foes, allowing Champions to deal $(not_buffed amount)% more damage against them for each Hunter in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Hunters also count as Laurana's Soldiers.

effect_keys.override_key_desc: $target does $amount% more damage against Laurana's Favored Foes.

description.desc: 劳拉娜获得猎人角色定位。龙族和怪兽成为她的偏好对手，阵型中每有一位猎人勇士，勇士们可以对这两类敌人额外造成 $(not_buffed amount)% 的伤害，以乘算方式堆叠。猎人勇士也算作劳拉娜的士兵。

effect_keys.override_key_desc: $target会对劳拉娜的偏好对手造成额外 $amount% 的伤害

specializationDescription.original: Laurana seeks to destroy every Dragon enemy she can find and recruits other Hunters to join her as her Soldiers.
specializationDescription.display: 劳拉娜试图消灭她能找到的每一名龙族敌人，并招募其他猎人作为她的士兵加入她的军队。

description.desc: Laurana increases the health of all other Champions in the formation by 10% of her max health, plus 2% for each Campaign stack, stacking additively.
劳拉娜提升阵型中所有其他勇士的生命值，提升的数值为她最大生命值的 10%，每有一层“战役”堆叠层数再加 2%，以加算方式堆叠。

Laurana counts the number of enemies that have spawned in the current area, with bosses counting as the same as three times the number of Campaign stacks she has. Laurana increases the effect of her Battle Plan specialization choice by $(not_buffed amount)% for each one of these enemies, stacking multiplicatively and capped at 70.
劳拉娜统计当前区域中刷新的敌人数量，其中每个首领按她拥有的“战役”堆叠层数乘以三计数。每有一名敌人，劳拉娜会使她“作战计划”专精选择的效果提高 $(not_buffed amount)%，以乘算方式堆叠，上限为 70。
Laurana and Quallathon deal one ultimate hit to all enemies, and encourage her allies.
劳拉娜与奎里安对所有敌人造成一次杀招打击，并激励她的盟友。

description.original: Damn it, Laurana! Live your own life! ~Sturm
description.display: 该死，劳拉娜！过你自己的人生吧！~斯特姆

description.original: You can command, Laurana. Your light will shine in this world. ~Sturm
description.display: 你可以发号施令，劳拉娜。你的光芒将照耀这个世界。~斯特姆

description.original: We are losing time. The girl has made her decision. ~Raistlin
description.display: 我们这是在耽误时间。那个女孩已经下定决心了。~雷斯林

description.original: How long has it been since you slept? ~Flint
description.display: 你有多久没睡觉了？~弗林特

description.original: Sometimes you must risk your life for something you believe in.  ~Laurana
description.display: 有时候你必须为你所信仰的东西冒生命危险。~劳拉娜

description.original: You are the only one who can save us now. ~Elistan
description.display: 你现在是唯一能拯救我们的人了。~伊力斯坦

description.original: If you make this decision, the burden of leadership will be upon you. ~Elistan
description.display: 如果你做了这个决定，领导的重担就落在你的肩上了。~伊力斯坦

description.original: Savor your victory now, for it will be short-lived. ~Kitiara
description.display: 好好享受你现在的胜利吧，因为它很快就会消失。~奇蒂拉

description.original: The past is lost. Your future is your own. ~Astinus
description.display: 过去已不可挽回。你的未来掌握在你自己手中。~阿斯特纽斯

description.original: I know that my people are wrong. Laurana is right. ~Gilthanas
description.display: 我知道我的族人错了。劳拉娜才是对的。~吉尔赛纳斯

description.display: 我不想有条理地思考！我讨厌总是要保持理性！~劳拉娜

description.display: 不管她说了什么，那似乎起作用了。~斯特姆

description.original: I am not a knight.
description.display: 我不是骑士。

description.original: I am Lauralanthalasa, daughter of the Qualinesti.
description.display: 我是奎灵尼斯的女儿，劳拉兰萨拉萨。

description.original: We elves have our own code of honor.
description.display: 我们精灵有我们自己的荣誉准则。

description.original: I can see you quite well in this darkness. I could have killed you.
description.display: 我在这黑暗中看你看得清清楚楚。我本可杀了你。

description.original: I welcome you to Qualinost, honored guests.
description.display: 各位贵宾，欢迎你们来到奎灵尼斯。

description.original: What I did was the act of a lovesick girl. I foolishly endangered your lives.
description.display: 我过去所做的一切都是花痴少女的行为。我愚蠢地把你们的性命置于危险之中。

description.original: The knights are assembled. Waiting your command. ~Flint
description.display: 骑士集结完毕。正在等待您的命令。~弗林特

description.original: I will take the leadership of the armies.
description.display: 我来统领军队。

description.original: I'm not going back. I'm coming with you, Tanis.
description.display: 我不回去。我要和你一起去，塔尼斯。

description.original: I couldn't lose you, not again. I love you. I'll make you proud of me.
description.display: 我不能再失去你了。我爱你。我会让你为我骄傲的。

description.original: I will leave this place. I will take this lance and the head of a dragon.
description.display: 我要离开此地。我要执此长枪，取巨龙首级。

description.original: Wham! There goes one dragon! Wham! There goes another! ~Tas
description.display: 哇！干掉了一条龙！哇！又干掉了一条！~泰索

description.display: 英雄们被一圈渴望鲜血的利刃重重包围。~拉格特

description.original: You are my betrothed, remember?
description.display: 你是我的未婚夫，记得吗？

description.original: That was a long time ago. We were children, playing a game. ~Tanis
description.display: 那是很久以前的事了。我们那时还是孩子，只是在玩游戏。~塔尼斯

description.original: To Theros of the Silver Arm, I give the power to forge the dragonlance. ~Silvara
description.display: 我将锻造龙枪之力赐予银臂西罗。~西尔瓦拉

description.original: I didn't ride out of a children's story. I rode out of fire, darkness, and blood.
description.display: 我不是从童话故事里走出来的，我是从火焰、黑暗与鲜血里走出来的。

backstory.original: Lauralanthalasa Kanan was a pampered princess of the Qualinesti elves. Then the flames of evil dragons threatened her people and Laurana joined with other heroes to fight the Dragon Queen. In time, she became known as the Golden General: a renowned fighter, dragon rider, and brilliant battlefield commander. Now a living symbol of hope, Laurana fights to save her people and the world.
backstory.display: 劳拉兰萨拉萨·卡南曾是奎灵尼斯精灵一族备受宠爱的公主。然而，当邪恶巨龙的烈焰威胁到她的族人时，劳拉娜毅然加入其他英雄对抗龙女王的行列。时光流转，她被誉为“黄金将军”：一位著名的战士、龙骑士，以及卓越的战场指挥官。如今，作为希望的象征，劳拉娜为拯救她的族人与整个世界而战。

description.display: 劳拉娜攻击距离最近的敌人一次。

longDescription.original: Laurana nimbly attacks the closest enemy with her shortsword for one hit.
longDescription.display: 劳拉娜敏捷地用她的短剑攻击距离最近的敌人一次。

description.original: Laurana and Quallathon deal one ultimate hit to all enemies, and encourage her allies.
description.display: 劳拉娜与奎里安对所有敌人造成一次杀招打击，并激励她的盟友。

longDescription.original: Laurana and Quallathon deal one ultimate hit to all enemies, which additionally encourages her allies for a short while.
longDescription.display: 劳拉娜与奎里安对所有敌人造成一次杀招打击，并额外激励她的盟友一小段时间。

character_sheet_details.backstory: Lauralanthalasa Kanan was a pampered princess of the Qualinesti elves. Then the flames of evil dragons threatened her people and Laurana joined with other heroes to fight the Dragon Queen. In time, she became known as the Golden General: a renowned fighter, dragon rider, and brilliant battlefield commander. Now a living symbol of hope, Laurana fights to save her people and the world.
character_sheet_details.system_description: Laurana is a Support and Tanking Champion whose abilities grow in power as you complete her 20 Achievements, representing her rise from a sheltered elven princess to the legendary Golden General. She increases the damage of Champions in one of three columns behind her, and she excels when assigned with the right soldiers.

character_sheet_details.backstory: 劳拉兰萨拉萨·卡南曾是奎灵尼斯精灵一族备受宠爱的公主。然而，当邪恶巨龙的烈焰威胁到她的族人时，劳拉娜毅然加入其他英雄对抗龙女王的行列。时光流转，她被誉为“黄金将军”：一位著名的战士、龙骑士，以及卓越的战场指挥官。如今，作为希望的象征，劳拉娜为拯救她的族人与整个世界而战。
character_sheet_details.system_description: 劳拉娜是一位支援和坦克型勇士，随着你完成她的 20 项成就，她的能力会不断提升，这代表着她从受庇护的精灵公主成长为传奇“黄金将军”的历程。她会使她身后三列中的一列中的勇士伤害提高，而且在与合适的士兵搭配时表现尤为出色。

original.name: Battle Plan: Charge
original.specialization_description: Laurana orders a direct advance with her closest allies.

display.name: 作战计划：冲锋
display.specialization_description: 劳拉娜命令她最亲密的盟友与她一起发起正面冲锋。

original.name: Battle Plan: Outflank
original.specialization_description: Laurana attacks from unexpected angles to shatter enemy lines.

display.name: 作战计划：包抄
display.specialization_description: 劳拉娜从意想不到的角度杀出，撕碎敌人的防线。

original.name: Battle Plan: Fortify
original.specialization_description: Laurana reinforces the back, ensuring a devastating attack when the moment is right.

display.name: 作战计划：筑防
display.specialization_description: 劳拉娜巩固后方阵线，为时机成熟时发动毁灭性一击做好准备。

original.name: Lead the Attack
original.specialization_description: Laurana's keen tactics grants her Soldiers the ability to critically hit more often and more effectively.

display.name: 带头进攻
display.specialization_description: 劳拉娜高明的战术使她的士兵能够更频繁地打出暴击，并造成更高的伤害。

original.name: Protect the Vulnerable
original.specialization_description: Laurana increases her fortitude and recruits Soldiers that others may overlook.

display.name: 保护弱者
display.specialization_description: 劳拉娜使自身变得更加坚韧，并招募那些可能会被其他人忽视的士兵。

original.name: Wield the Dragonlance
original.specialization_description: Laurana seeks to destroy every Dragon enemy she can find and recruits other Hunters to join her as her Soldiers.

display.name: 挥舞龙枪
display.specialization_description: 劳拉娜试图消灭她能找到的每一名龙族敌人，并招募其他猎人作为她的士兵加入她的军队。

original.name: Selflessness
original.description: Damn it, Laurana! Live your own life! ~Sturm

display.name: 无私
display.description: 该死，劳拉娜！过你自己的人生吧！~斯特姆

original.name: Inspiring Leader
original.description: You can command, Laurana. Your light will shine in this world. ~Sturm

display.name: 鼓舞人心的首领
display.description: 你可以发号施令，劳拉娜。你的光芒将照耀这个世界。~斯特姆

original.name: Tough
original.description: We are losing time. The girl has made her decision. ~Raistlin

display.name: 坚定强大
display.description: 我们这是在耽误时间。那个女孩已经下定决心了。~雷斯林

original.name: Resilient
original.description: How long has it been since you slept? ~Flint

display.name: 坚韧不拔
display.description: 你有多久没睡觉了？~弗林特

original.name: Defensive Duelist
original.description: Sometimes you must risk your life for something you believe in.  ~Laurana

display.name: 防守型决斗者
display.description: 有时候你必须为你所信仰的东西冒生命危险。~劳拉娜

original.name: Calm Under Pressure
original.description: You are the only one who can save us now. ~Elistan

display.name: 从容应对
display.description: 你现在是唯一能拯救我们的人了。~伊力斯坦

original.name: Burden of Command
original.description: If you make this decision, the burden of leadership will be upon you. ~Elistan

display.description: 如果你做了这个决定，领导的重担就落在你的肩上了。~伊力斯坦

original.name: Soaring Higher
original.description: Let them have their hero. ~Lord Michael

display.name: 一飞冲天
display.description: 让他们拥有他们的英雄吧。~迈克尔大人

original.name: Golden Glory
original.description: You see, Tanis? I’m not the love-sick child you knew. ~Laurana

display.name: 金色荣耀
display.description: 看到没，塔尼斯？我不是你认识的那个犯花痴的孩子了。~劳拉娜

original.name: Brilliant Stratagem
original.description: Savor your victory now, for it will be short-lived. ~Kitiara

display.name: 精妙的计谋
display.description: 好好享受你现在的胜利吧，因为它很快就会消失。~奇蒂拉

original.name: Bound Destiny
original.description: The past is lost. Your future is your own. ~Astinus

display.name: 注定的命运
display.description: 过去已不可挽回。你的未来掌握在你自己手中。~阿斯特纽斯

original.name: Living Symbol
original.description: I know that my people are wrong. Laurana is right. ~Gilthanas

display.name: 活生生的象征
display.description: 我知道我的族人错了。劳拉娜才是对的。~吉尔赛纳斯

original.name: Taunt
original.description: Soliasi Arath! ~Laurana

display.name: 嘲讽
display.description: 有本事就上吧！~劳拉娜

original.name: Misdirection
original.description: I don't want to think logically! I'm sick of being sensible! ~Laurana

effects.description: Enemies that attempt to attack this Champion will instead attack a different Champion, if possible.

display.name: 误导
display.description: 我不想有条理地思考！我讨厌总是要保持理性！~劳拉娜

effects.description: 如果可能的话，试图攻击该英雄的敌人会转而攻击另一位英雄。

original.name: Qualinesti Princess
original.description: Well, whatever she said, it seems to have worked. ~Sturm

original.description: War has come, and now you must do what you can to win it. ~Astinus

display.description: 我不想做任何讨论。 我是将军。 这是我的决定。 ~劳拉娜

original.description: I am not a knight.

display.name: 童年之弓
display.description: 我不是骑士。

original.name: Qualinesti Bow
original.description: I am Lauralanthalasa, daughter of the Qualinesti.

display.name: 奎灵尼斯之弓
display.description: 我是奎灵尼斯的女儿，劳拉兰萨拉萨。

original.name: Commander's Longbow
original.description: We elves have our own code of honor.

display.name: 指挥官之弓
display.description: 我们精灵有我们自己的荣誉准则。

original.name: The First Strike
original.description: I can see you quite well in this darkness. I could have killed you.

display.name: 第一击
display.description: 我在这黑暗中看你看得清清楚楚。我本可杀了你。

original.name: Flimsy Tunic
original.description: I welcome you to Qualinost, honored guests.

display.name: 单薄的罩衣
display.description: 各位贵宾，欢迎你们来到奎灵尼斯。

original.name: Elven Chain
original.description: What I did was the act of a lovesick girl. I foolishly endangered your lives.

display.name: 精灵锁甲
display.description: 我过去所做的一切都是花痴少女的行为。我愚蠢地把你们的性命置于危险之中。

original.name: Commander's Plate
original.description: The knights are assembled. Waiting your command. ~Flint

display.name: 指挥官板甲
display.description: 骑士集结完毕。正在等待您的命令。~弗林特

original.name: Golden Regalia
original.description: I will take the leadership of the armies.

display.name: 御用金甲
display.description: 我来统领军队。

original.name: Broken Dragonlance
original.description: I'm not going back. I'm coming with you, Tanis.

display.name: 破损的龙枪
display.description: 我不回去。我要和你一起去，塔尼斯。

original.name: Desperate Hope
original.description: I couldn't lose you, not again. I love you. I'll make you proud of me.

display.name: 绝望中的希望
display.description: 我不能再失去你了。我爱你。我会让你为我骄傲的。

original.name: Restored Dragonlance
original.description: I will leave this place. I will take this lance and the head of a dragon.

display.name: 修复的龙枪
display.description: 我要离开此地。我要执此长枪，取巨龙首级。

original.name: Hope of Whitestone
original.description: Wham! There goes one dragon! Wham! There goes another! ~Tas

display.name: 白石的希望
display.description: 哇！干掉了一条龙！哇！又干掉了一条！~泰索

original.name: Mangled Pelt
original.description: Around the heroes a circle of knives of craving. ~Raggart

original.description: I know how the orb works! I know how to kill the dragons!

display.description: 我知道这宝珠怎么用！我知道怎样杀死巨龙！

original.name: Promise Ring
original.description: You are my betrothed, remember?

display.name: 定情戒指
display.description: 你是我的未婚夫，记得吗？

original.name: Broken Promise
original.description: That was a long time ago. We were children, playing a game. ~Tanis

display.name: 失信的承诺
display.description: 那是很久以前的事了。我们那时还是孩子，只是在玩游戏。~塔尼斯

original.name: Storied Tools
original.description: To Theros of the Silver Arm, I give the power to forge the dragonlance. ~Silvara

display.name: 传奇工具
display.description: 我将锻造龙枪之力赐予银臂西罗。~西尔瓦拉

original.name: General's Helm
original.description: I didn't ride out of a children's story. I rode out of fire, darkness, and blood.

display.name: 将军头盔
display.description: 我不是从童话故事里走出来的，我是从火焰、黑暗与鲜血里走出来的。
